title: Flatpack list composition
description: Contract for `list.yaml` (JSON-decoded). Defines list columns, actions, filters, tabs, and normalized table behavior.

model.description: Fully qualified Eloquent model class name.

icon.description: Lucide icon name for navigation and headers.

nav_order.description: Sidebar sort weight; lower values appear first.

menu.description: Sidebar menu section for this list link (`main`, `secondary`, or `bottom`).

oneOf.description: When true, use the default reorder column (`sort_order`).
Database column name used for manual row order.

reorderable.description: Drag-and-drop reorder configuration: `true` for default column or a column name string.

row_click.description: Row click behavior for list rows.

tabs.description: Tab panel map keyed by tab id with optional column and filter overrides.

filters.description: Filter map keyed by column id.

actions.description: Header toolbar actions map keyed by action id.

bulk_actions.description: Bulk actions map keyed by action id.

widgets.description: Root widget map keyed by widget id.

default_sort.description: Default sort applied when request sorting is absent.

pagination.description: Pagination visibility override: true always shows controls, false always hides controls.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the table toolbar.

scope.description: Optional model query scope for this tab (e.g. `trashed`, `draftOnly`).

oneOf.description: Optional tab-level override for drag-and-drop row reordering.
Optional tab-level reorder column id override.

row_click.description: Optional tab-level override for row click behavior.

columns.description: Optional tab-only column set. When omitted, this tab uses root-level `columns`.

filters.description: Optional tab-only filter overrides. When set, replaces root-level `filters` for this tab.

bulk_actions.description: Optional tab-only bulk actions (`snake_case`). When set, replaces root-level `bulk_actions` for this tab.

bulkActions.description: Optional tab-only bulk actions (`camelCase` alias of `bulk_actions`).

default_sort.description: Optional tab-level default sort applied when request sorting is absent.

listTabPanel.description: List tab panel definition with optional scope, columns, filters, and bulk action overrides.

validationRules.description: Laravel validation rules as a pipe-delimited string or string array.

listActionsBlock.description: Header toolbar actions map keyed by action id.

primary.description: When true, this list header action is treated as the primary CTA where that matters for defaults.

submit.description: Reserved for parity with form actions; list actions are always non-form submissions.

headerActionEntry.description: List header action definition. Requires exactly one of `action` or `href`.

bulkActionDefinition.description: Bulk action definition for selected table rows.

editFormFieldDefinition.description: Embedded edit field type definition used by column edit forms.

oneOf.description: Alias for list (redirect to entity index after success).

successRedirect.description: Post-action redirect target keyword, or `true` as alias for `list`.

actionInactiveUntil.description: Action gating definition that disables actions until predicates pass.

actionInactivePredicate.description: Single predicate used by `enabled_if` or `visible_if` gating rules.

listColumnType.description: Raw YAML column types before list-specific rendering and filter normalization.

columnOption.description: Column option object with value, label, and optional status metadata.

optionStatus.description: Status token used by option badges and chips.

columnOptions.description: Column options as an array of option objects or keyed map form.

success_message.description: Shown as a success toast after the row action completes (same as header toolbar and bulk actions).

confirm.description: When true, opens a confirmation dialog before submitting the row action.

columnActionButton.description: Per-row action button definition used in `actions` columns.

columnSharedProps.description: Shared column properties used across all column type variants.

columnDefinition.description: Discriminated column union keyed by `type`, with text-like fallback when omitted.

columnSelect.description: Select-style column definition with options and optional relation metadata.

columnRelation.description: Relation column definition for displaying related model values.

columnActions.description: Actions column definition containing one or more row action buttons.

columnDate.description: Date or datetime column definition with format and range filtering options.

columnGeneric.description: Generic text-like column definition for text, badge, status, and similar display types.

options.description: Optional filter-level options. When provided, these override column options.

filterSelect.description: Select filter definition with optional option overrides.

filterDate.description: Date filter definition with optional min and max boundaries.

filterOverrides.description: Label and placeholder overrides for inherited filter definitions.

defaultSort.description: Default table sort used when request sorting is missing.

oneOf.description: Pagination visibility override: true always shows controls, false always hides controls.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the widget table toolbar.
Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the widget table toolbar.

provider.description: Key in config `flatpack.widget_providers` used to resolve runtime data.

color.description: Series stroke/fill: an `optionStatus` token (same as select option badges) or any CSS color string.

x_key.description: Optional data key for the X axis (dates or categories). Defaults to date.

mode.description: Chart render mode. Defaults to area when omitted.

variant.description: Area-only variant. area_stacked is the default when mode is area.

time_ranges.description: Optional range filters. When omitted, range controls are hidden and all points are shown.

provider.description: Key in config `flatpack.widget_providers` used to resolve runtime data.

data.description: Populated at runtime from the widget provider; omitted in YAML.

chartWidgetResolvedData.description: Shape returned from a WidgetPayload provider (merged into the widget as `data`; table widgets also merge `columns` from the provider onto the widget definition).

points.description: Time series or category rows; each point must include `chart.x_key` and series value keys.

widgetStatus.description: Card widget status token used by status badges.
